features: NO SCHEMA CHANGES, BUT TRANSFERS AND CANCELLATIONS SAVE SOME NEW INFORMATION IN THEIR RECORD — The cancellation of a sale, a usufruct or a succession remembers how far the plans' shares went at that moment, so as to tell the plans recalculated afterwards; the end of a tenant's lease remembers the part of an earlier stop that rises; the start of a lease remembers the part of the pair of balance rows that the new tenant took, and who was paying those days; the stops remember the tenant whose end gave rise to them and, when several transfers stop on the same person, the list of those transfers. Also the shares of a plan generated after a succession with the arrears passed to the heirs, when the generation gate names the deceased, remember in the calculation parameters the person, the unit and the figure stated. No migration and no existing data rewritten: transfers recorded earlier do not have this information and are read as before, and earlier cancellations, which do not remember that point, are read by the time alone (when in doubt, the plan has to be recalculated). The closing of the transfers. With beta.50 the lease got its choice; this one takes the accounts that, after a transfer, could stay wrong without the program saying so, and makes it say so or stops them: a plan that still follows a cancelled transfer, a tenant who leaves after a sale, a deceased person whom a plan still calculates, a joint-liability note that counted the same figure twice, a statement that gave one person the days of another. Every calculation defect and every server sentence first had a red test; the fixes went through an adversarial review, a round on the fixes and an on-screen check. The defects found in the new functions are fixed before release and do not appear among the fixes, which only concern what was already there.

CHANGED: AFTER A CANCELLATION, A TRANSFER THAT WOULD TAKE A PLAN TO BE RECALCULATED IS NOT RECORDED — If a sale, a usufruct or a succession was recorded, the instalment plan was recalculated with that transfer and the transfer was then cancelled, the plan's shares still carry the ownership of a transfer that no longer exists. A new transfer on the same unit, whose settlement would take that plan (in a succession and in a lease, only with «Write») while a payment, a used credit or a settlement already written on one of its shares prevents its recalculation, would write the pair of balance rows on those shares, and the pair would come out wrong. Now the «What will change» panel puts an amber box above the settlement: «First recalculate the plan …, then record this transfer», with the cancelled transfer, the reason why the recalculation is refused today and the steps up to the recalculation. The panel stays, with the settlement and the way out: the box «The parties settled between themselves» in a sale and a usufruct, «Don't write it» in a succession and in the end of a lease. Until you recalculate the plan or choose not to write the settlement, «Record transfer» stays off, with a line saying why; and the recording, even with a hand-built request, is refused before anything is written (error on the transfer field). It does not refuse with «Don't write it», while the choice is not yet made, or for a transfer cancelled on another unit of the same plan.

CHANGED: AFTER A CANCELLATION THE PLAN IS RECALCULATED BEFORE ISSUING, COLLECTING OR REFUNDING — A plan generated or recalculated between the recording of a sale, a usufruct or a succession and its cancellation has its shares with the ownership of the transfer and, issued like that, would send to the journal the shares of someone who is no longer the owner. In the example, a sale from Ugo to Elsa on 1 May on an ordinary budget of € 1,200.00: after the recalculation the shares are € 394.52 for Ugo and € 805.48 for Elsa; with the sale cancelled, the issue up to 30 June sent to the journal € 197.28 to Ugo and € 402.76 to Elsa (€ 600.04 in all, because of the rounding of the instalments), instead of € 600.00 to Ugo. Now the plan counts among those that still have to follow a transfer, even if the transfer was cancelled: issuing, collecting (also with a used credit) and refunding are refused until you recalculate it, and say which transfer was cancelled and whose shares would go to the journal («… so that it goes back to the earlier ownership: issued like this, Elsa's shares would go to the journal for a transfer that no longer exists»). The recalculation, if the plan has a movement, is refused as before and says that it will then bring the shares back to the earlier ownership. It also applies to the creation and the termination of a usufruct, to a succession and to a sale with the garage, which is a single transfer. Nothing changes if the plan was not recalculated after the transfer (the shares were already there and go back as they were), if the recalculation was done after the cancellation, if the effective date is beyond the end of the plan's financial year or if the cancellation would change no share (an extraordinary expense decided before the sale). The lease stays out. For cancellations made before this beta, which do not remember the point, the time alone counts: when in doubt the guard triggers, and a recalculation removes it.

CHANGED: THE END OF A TENANT'S LEASE AFTER A SALE STOPS AND ASKS FOR THE TICK — Ines leaves on 24 January with «Write» (the pair, € 355.52, goes to Ugo), Luca enters on 8 February, Ugo sells to Elsa on 12 March and Luca's lease ends on 18 April. Elsa pays the 258 days after Luca's end, but the pair is in Ugo's name: € 268.20 of Elsa's stayed with Ugo, silently. The panel for Luca's end said nothing, and the record remembered nothing. Now the end of the lease of a tenant who entered later is a stop like the others after «Write»: if the days he covered return to whoever pays in place of the tenant and this is no longer whoever took the pair (they sold, the usufruct passed, the owner died), the program records the end, does not move that part and says so with the person, the figure and the manual route; it asks for the tick «I have read what will change» and the note, and the history and the record of the end keep the stop (in the example € 268.20 towards Elsa, borne by Ugo). The manual route is the manual balance from the Wallet if neither of the two people already has a balance on that management, unit and year; otherwise the part is settled between the parties. The figure is the variation of the part of whoever receives those days and does not already hold the pair. It is not a stop when those days go to another tenant (a co-tenant, or whoever enters in his place with a change of tenant in one step) or to someone who already holds the pair. If an earlier stop already contained those days, the part to settle rises instead of arising: Ines leaves on 1 July (pair of € 181.48 to Ugo), Ugo sells to Elsa on 1 October (stop of € 90.74), Luca enters on 1 November (the part towards Elsa falls to € 30.58) and his lease ends on 1 December, and the part towards Elsa rises from € 30.58 to € 61.15. The panel, the gate, the history and the record say it from how much to how much, and cancelling the end warns that the part goes back as it was.

CHANGED: THE JOINT-LIABILITY NOTE GIVES THE FIGURE NET OF THE PAIR — In the account statement, in the debt position and in the collection screen, the note that recalls the joint liability of the buyer (art. 63, fourth paragraph, and art. 67 of the implementing provisions of the Italian Civil Code) says how much appears unpaid in the seller's name. After a «Write» settlement the pair has already put part of those instalments as a debit of the buyer, and the note counted it twice: with an ordinary budget of € 1,200.00 fully issued, a sale on 1 May and nothing paid, it said € 1,200.00, while € 805.48 were already a debit of Elsa; Ugo's part, 120/365 of € 1,200.00, is € 394.52. Now the figure is net and the pair is in the same sentence: «in Ugo's name today € 394.52 appear unpaid on this unit (€ 1,200.00 in the instalments, of which € 805.48 already a debit of Elsa with the settlement of 1 May 2026)». With the instalments issued up to 30 June the figure is the same, € 394.52 (€ 600.00 in the instalments, of which € 205.48); if the net is zero it says that nothing unpaid appears and that the instalments are all already a debit of the buyer. It applies to the full sale and to the usufruct reserve, management by management: the credit of one does not cover the debit of another. With the waiver of the settlement, or after it is cancelled, there is no pair and the figure stays gross; if the pair has been absorbed by a second plan, the note goes back to the gross figure, which never understates the debt.

CHANGED: THE GENERATION GATE NAMES THE DECEASED — Ugo dies on 1 May; the succession passes the arrears to the heirs, Anna at 60 % and Bruno at 40 %. An ordinary plan of € 1,200.00 generated or recalculated afterwards still calculates Ugo for his days up to the death: Ugo € 394.52, Anna € 483.29 and Bruno € 322.19. Those instalments arise now, outside the arrears, and no row passed them to the heirs: the sentence «the deceased's position is closed» suggested the opposite. Now the gate that opens at generation (creation of the plan, recalculation, «remove an item») adds an entry: «The succession of Ugo (death on 1 May 2026) passed the arrears to the heirs, but this plan still calculates for Ugo € 394.52 … The heirs answer for it, each for their share (art. 754 of the Italian Civil Code): Anna € 236.71 and Bruno € 157.81». Then it says the route: a manual balance from the Wallet on the same management (€ 394.52 as a credit of Ugo, € 236.71 as a debit of Anna and € 157.81 as a debit of Bruno), which the plan absorbs at the next generation; if someone already has a balance on that management and unit, the part is settled between the parties. If the plan does not apply the Wallet balances it says so: it has to be created again or, at creation, the balances recorded and the form sent again. After the balances are recorded the gate comes back at every recalculation, but with another sentence: «The balances are already there … this plan absorbs them in their shares with this generation. There is nothing else to record»; it applies only if the balances really are the part (the figure for each, in the right direction, to within a cent): with simple carried-over amounts, of another figure, it stays «settled between the parties». Several successions of the same deceased on the same unit (ownership and bare ownership) divide the figure by role, whatever the order of recording; where a piece cannot be attributed, the entry names the successions and says that the administrator decides the division. The succession form too says that the deceased's position is closed on what is already there.

CHANGED: THE PREVIEW OF THE START OF A LEASE REFUSES WHAT THE RECORDING REFUSES — Ugo, Ines as tenant at 100 %, instalments issued up to 30 June. The preview of Luca's start at 100 % from 1 July answered that it was possible, the panel proposed the transfer, and the recording refused: «the sum of the tenants' shares cannot exceed 100: on 1 July 2026 it would be 200». Now the preview refuses with the same text and on the same field (the share for the unit, the appurtenances for the garage: Ines at 50 % and Luca at 100 % on the garage make 150). It also refuses the overlap with an already finished tenant row of the entering person (from 1 May to 31 August, against a start on 1 July), on the field «who enters». The refusal writes nothing, and the same rule applies at the recording before anything is written.

CHANGED: THE STATEMENT DOES NOT GIVE ONE PERSON AN ITEM THAT ACCRUES AFTER A CHANGE OF TENANT — An expense item of € 400.00 with a period from 1 October to 31 December, 30 % of it for the tenant (€ 120.00). Ines hands her place to Marco on 1 April with «Write» in a single step, Marco's lease ends on 1 July with «Write» and Luca enters on 1 October. The item is all after the change: it is not Ines's. The statement gave Ines € 208.77 instead of € 88.77 and Luca € 90.74 instead of € 210.74: € 120.00 to Ugo's detriment (with «Don't write it» in the change, to Ines's). The cause: to know who pays an item the statement looked for a tenant's end only among the ends without a new tenant, and did not see the change. An income item is not needed: an item with a period entirely after the change is enough. Now it follows the chain at every step: Ines stays with € 88.77 and Luca reimburses Ugo the € 120.00 that Ugo paid with the pair (€ 210.74 in all); with «Don't write it» in the change he reimburses them to Ines, who has them in her instalments.

CHANGED: SEVERAL STOPS ON THE SAME PERSON: THE REMAINDER IS A SINGLE ONE — Ugo and Anna, co-owners at 50 %, sell to Elsa on 12 March and 1 April; each of the two sales stops on Elsa's part (€ 153.33 and € 142.94, € 296.27 in all). Then Marco enters on 1 June and takes € 222.46 from Elsa. Beta.50 subtracted that € 222.46 from each of the two stops, and each fell to zero by itself: the panel said «nothing is left to settle» with € 73.81 still to settle. Now the remainder is one, per person who receives, and the panel says it in a sentence that names the stops. With several people liable the remainder stays a single one for all of them together: the sentence says the figure of each stop (here € 153.33 for Ugo and € 142.94 for Anna) and that the part of each is decided by the administrator.

CHANGED: A START THAT BRINGS A STOP TO ZERO IS INFORMATION — In the example of Luca's end that stops € 268.20 towards Elsa, Marco enters on the same day, 18 April, and takes over the 258 days: Elsa's part goes back to zero. Luca's end already asked for the tick for € 268.20; Marco's start does not ask for a second one: the panel says that nothing is left to settle between the parties (before it was € 268.20), as information, with no tick and no note. If for the earlier stop you had recorded the balance from the Wallet (€ 268.20 as a credit of Ugo and € 268.20 as a debit of Elsa), the sentence says to correct it, because the program does not remove it; with the stop «between the parties» this line does not appear. The rule is a zero remainder, not the same day: with a remainder that stays, the gate's reason stays. Cancelling the start that had reduced or brought a stop to zero warns that the part goes back from € 0.00 to € 268.20 and that agreements or balances adjusted in the meantime have to be reviewed.

SENTENCES AND PRINTOUTS: THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE SALE'S SETTLEMENT AND THE PLAN GENERATED AFTERWARDS — Where the amount already paid belongs both to the person and to the unit on the same account, the settlement and the plan generated after the sale give two different figures. With an expense of € 1,200.00 on 100 % of the owner, Ugo having paid € 300.00, the unit € 200.00 and the sale on 1 May, the settlement gives € 671.23 to Elsa and € 28.77 to Ugo; the plan generated afterwards, € 626.48 and € 73.52: the difference of € 44.75 was not stated anywhere. Now the settlement sentence says the two figures and the difference, and also the share of a co-owner or of the tenant that changes in the later plan (Anna € 480.33 instead of € 466.67). With an on-account plan it applies to the amount already paid the same fraction as the plan (Elsa € 313.24 and Ugo € 36.76 against € 335.62 and € 14.38: € 22.38). It also states the case where Ugo's amount already paid exceeds his part, or the unit's exceeds the expense that remains (in a tested case € 201.37 to Elsa against € 0.00), with the figures. It does not appear when only one party has paid, where the two routes coincide to the cent, nor when the buyer is already on the plan, nor when the difference is one cent.

SENTENCES AND PRINTOUTS: A NEGATIVE FIGURE IS SAID IN WORDS — In the settlement sentences a negative net was written «€ -100.83» and read as a debit or a credit of opposite sign: now it says a credit of € 100.83 to Elsa and a debit of € 100.83 to Ugo, and a reimbursement line says «€ 100.82 as a credit of the person who enters». «They cover more than his days» is said only if the part and the drafts have the same sign and the drafts exceed the part in absolute value. The lines of the reassignment and the reasons of the gate follow the same rule, and the line of an income item that accrues after the transfer says «the income belongs entirely to the person who enters».

SENTENCES AND PRINTOUTS: THE PRINTOUT OF THE ANCILLARY CHARGES STATEMENT — In the foot of the sections, in the «Days without a tenant» block and in the final sentence no figure is printed with «€ -» any more: a negative total is «in favour of» whoever has it, a credit of whoever paid the days without a tenant is «a credit», and «to be given back to … the days after his exit» is said only of someone who left (a tenant still there, to whom whoever paid his days owes money, receives it). The «Amount» column of the rows keeps the sign instead: the direction is told by the «How» column. With an income of € 1,000.00 that exceeds the expense of the days without a tenant the foot says € 118.52 as a credit; for Luca, with the pair in credit, the section says «Total in favour of Luca € 209.26» and the final sentence lists the figures per person.

SENTENCES AND PRINTOUTS: ONE DIRECTION PER PAYER, AND THE CREDIT OF THE PERSON WHO ENTERS — When the payers of the days have different directions, the sentence of Luca's start says that Luca reimburses € 87.36 to Elsa and that Ugo gives him back € 3.49, and not «Luca reimburses them to Ugo and Elsa»; the panel and the statement say the same names, directions and figures. If in a change of tenant the entering person has a credit (in the example € 209.26), the sentence says that it passes to him, and with «Don't write it» that it is the leaving person who gives the difference back, not who reimburses. A 1.10 plan with no allocation recorded, with an income chapter, says that the parties settle in the direction of the items: the data on who reimburses whom is not there, and the program does not guess.

SENTENCES AND PRINTOUTS: THE GARAGE TICKED IN A LEASE — With the garage ticked, three panel sentences (the leaving person's overdue amount, the count of issued shares and what does not change) were imprecise: the overdue amount counted only the main unit, and «12 shares on this unit» included the garage's shares. Now they count the unit and the ticked appurtenances and say so («on the unit and the ticked appurtenances»); the overdue amount of Ines's end is € 180.00 (€ 162.00 on the unit and € 18.00 on the garage), with the division in brackets. At Luca's start, if the two units have the same history the sentence is a single one, without the unit's name; with another owner on the garage there are still two.

FIXES — A date of the deed sent as a list by a hand-built request, together with an expiry date of the contract, made an error page appear instead of the message on the field: now the preview and the recording of a transfer answer with the error on the field and write nothing. In the sentences of the «What will change» panel, of the gate and of the history the € symbol stayed at the end of the line, detached from the figure: now € 268.20 stays together. The notes written by the administrator stay as they were.

ERRATUM TO BETA.50 — The «Not yet» of beta.50 said that the printout of the statement, when the person who left has to receive a refund, says the reversed direction and a figure with a minus sign. It was the opposite: the case was that of an income that, in the days after the exit, exceeds the expense, and then the refund does not go to the person who left but is owed by him. With an end of lease on 1 July with «Don't write it» and an income of € 1,000.00 on the tenant's 30 %, the printout said «Total to be given back to whoever paid them, between the parties, € -118.52» (expenses of € 181.48 and an income of € 300.00 in the 184 days after the exit): it is the person who left, who has the whole year in his instalments, who has to give back € 118.52. From beta.51 the printout says «Total that the person who left has to give back, between the parties». The other case of that «Not yet», a change of tenant in a single step followed by the end of the person who had entered, was not only about incomes either: an item with a period entirely after the change was enough, and it was already there in beta.48.

THE GUIDES — The transfer guide says that the end of a tenant who entered later also stops (with the example from € 30.58 to € 61.15), that after a cancellation the plan has to be recalculated before issuing, collecting or refunding and that a new transfer that would take it is not recorded, that the start of a lease that exceeds the shares is already refused in the preview, that a start that brings a stop to zero is information, that the joint-liability note is net of the pair, that the deceased's gate comes back after the balances and that the statement follows the items along the changes of tenant. The «creating an instalment plan» guide says the deceased's gate, the «instalment plan detail» guide the recalculation after a cancellation, and the «opening balances» guide the manual route for a part that the program does not move.

NOT YET — Income items (antenna rent, for example) still have cases outside the transfers that give wrong figures without saying so, and that were already there in 1.10: «Move expense» between an expense and an income (the plan total changes by double the amount moved), an invoice or an immediate adjustment recorded on an income item, and a negative amount written on an expense item instead of choosing the type «Income»; the badge «Misaligned: recalculate!» is lit on every plan with an income. They will be fixed in the next beta, and until then it is better to avoid those three operations. The actual collection of an income from third parties, such as the antenna rent paid to the condominium, is not recorded yet: it arrives with the final accounts. Declared limits of the transfers: the sentence on the difference between the settlement and the plan generated afterwards is silent when part of a share is sold and when the plan asks for a part of the item that the program cannot state (the amount of the chapter divided among the sub-accounts in a way that differs from their sum); with several people liable for a stop the remainder is a single one and the part of each is decided by the administrator; if the deceased's gate finds a single balance that includes a carried-over amount and the part (the Wallet keeps one per person, management, unit and year), it does not know how much is carried over and says «settled between the parties»; the gate also comes back when the deceased's net part is zero, with the sentence «the balances are already there», and does not stay silent; if the pair is absorbed by a second plan the joint-liability note stays gross. Under the amber box of the plan to be recalculated the settlement still shows the figures of the plan as it is (in a tested case € 115.06 instead of € 1.78): the box says to recalculate the plan first and the recording does not go through. The page of a plan that follows a cancelled transfer does not say so: the refusal of the issue and the preview of a new transfer do. The preview refuses like the recording the excess shares at the start of a lease; for the other types of transfer the comparison is not yet done. Still open from beta.50 are a Wallet row tied to the transfer that is removed with the cancellation, the end of a lease with a co-tenant who stays and the plan's rule, and, at 375 px, the breadcrumb at the top of the page, which overflows by 16 px with a very long condominium name.

FOR DEVELOPERS — No migration: the new keys live in the transfer's JSON record. `annullamento.quota_max_id` is the highest share id at the moment of the cancellation; `fermata_risale` (with `prima` and `dopo`) and `giorni_del_conduttore` are keys of the transfer; inside `fermata_dopo_scrivi` there are `conduttore_uscente` and `conduttore_uscente_id` (the tenant whose end gave rise to the stop) and inside `fermata_ridotta` `passaggi_ids`, `passaggi` and `persone` (one remainder per group of stops, not per stop). The preview response carries `rate.piano_da_ricalcolare`, `rate.fermate_risalgono` and `rate.giorni_del_conduttore`; the joint-liability note adds `residuo_lordo_cents` and `coppia_cents`, and `residuo_uscente_cents` becomes the net. New classes: `DefuntoNelPiano` (the `defunto_nel_piano` entry of the generation gate), `QuoteNateDopoIlPassaggio` (the rule for the shares born after a transfer, a single one for the cancellation warnings and for `PianoRate::passaggiDaSeguire`, which now also sees cancelled transfers) and `ImportoInParole` (figures said in words, previously inside `FermataDopoScrivi`). `FermataDopoScrivi::perLaFineDelConduttore` is the stop for the end of a tenant's lease; `GeneratePianoRateAction::saldiSiApplicano` is the balances rule extracted from the body of the generation, and `GeneratePianoRateAction::execute` has the new parameter `allaCreazione`; on the plan's shares `regole_calcolo.parametri.titolarita_alla` carries, when the gate names a deceased person, the key `defunti` (person, unit and figure); `ConguaglioPassaggio::confrontoConIlPiano` is a declared second source of the difference sentence, compared with the plan really generated. On the page side `FraseConImporti.vue` and `importoSenzaACapo.ts`. New tests: `Beta51PassaggiFineConduttoreTest`, `Beta51PassaggiParteCheRisaleTest`, `Beta51PassaggiDueFermateTest`, `Beta51PassaggiRegistroInizioTest`, `Beta51PassaggiEntrateTest`, `Beta51PassaggiFrasiTest`, `Beta51PassaggiInizioSopraTest`, `Beta51PianoRatePassaggioAnnullatoTest`, `Beta51PianoRateDefuntoNelPianoTest`, `Beta51PianoRateNotaCoppiaTest` and the vitest `AnteprimaPassaggioPianoDaRicalcolare`, `PassaggioNewPianoDaRicalcolare`, `DestinatariWarningDefunto`, `FraseConImporti`, `importoSenzaACapo`, `PassaggioNewImportiSenzaACapo`, `Beta51ImportiSenzaACapo`, `PassaggioProprietaGuide`; rewritten `RiservaUsufruttoTest`, `RegistraSubentroTest`, `InizioLocazionePianoFermoTest` and `ConguaglioPerTrattiTest`.
